description: This file defines functions related to determining terminal color support levels based on environment variables and runtime conditions. It exports a main function `colorSupport` that assesses the environment and stream characteristics to set color support levels, along with helper functions like `hasNone`, `hasBasic`, `has256`, and `has16m` to configure support levels.

methods.name: hasNone(obj, options)
methods.description: Sets the color support object to none (level 0) and returns it, unless the 'alwaysReturn' option is false, in which case it returns false.

methods.name: hasBasic(obj)
methods.description: Sets the color support object to basic (level 1).

methods.name: has256(obj)
methods.description: Sets the color support object to 256 color support (level 2).

methods.name: has16m(obj)
methods.description: Sets the color support object to 16 million colors (true color) support (level 3).

methods.name: colorSupport(options, obj)
methods.description: Determines the level of terminal color support based on options, environment variables, and runtime conditions, returning an object with support levels or configuring the object passed to it.
